I can't confirm that. The evidence is insufficient for the full period (2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04).

NASA FIRMS recorded zero thermal detections intersecting the property on the days that were covered. Those days run from 5 October to 3 November for MODIS, VIIRS NOAA-20 and VIIRS NOAA-21, and for VIIRS S-NPP they run through 3 November as well. The last day, 3–4 November, is not covered by any sensor because the near-real-time data had not yet been updated for it.

Even for the covered days, a lack of detections does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The data also says nothing about burned area or about anything outside this period.

So the most you can say is that no fire was detected through 3 November, with the final day unassessed.
